text:
raj: CI alert - audit-validation failing in staging after yesterday's RBAC change. Golden fixture compare shows keystore events mismatched. sample fail:
```
AssertionError: event.actor.id missing
expected: {
  "actor": {
    "id": "svc-xxxx",
    "type": "service"
  }
}
actual: {
  "actor": {
    "service_actor": {
      "name": "keystore-daemon"
    }
  }
}
```
Anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:

maria: yup, I hit this locally. RBAC change flattened actor -> we unintentionally renamed actor.id -> service_actor.name in the code path that writes events. Validator schema still expects actor.id.

sam: attaching a trimmed validator log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T22:05:12Z validator ERROR event[keystore/emit] - schema:actor.id: missing
2026-03-19T22:05:12Z validator INFO  golden-compare: mismatch for keystore/rotate-key
```

lee: could KMS rotation be related? We rotated staging master key and changed envelope.kms_ref -> kms.key_id in the keystore push. If the event serializer reads the new envelope shape but the validator/goldens expect the old one, that'll show up as mismatch.

maria: good catch. The keystore serializer change included a small refactor that also changed actor wrapping in a different commit. Two independent changes landed the same day. That explains why CI started failing after the RBAC PR plus KMS key rename.

security-oncall: tagging as P2 for now. Potential customer-facing audit regressions (missing actor fields) — assign to @maria and @sam to triage and ship fix. If we confirm customer-facing loss, escalate to P1.

raj: agreed. short-term plan: 1) add a compatibility branch in the validator to accept old actor.service_actor.name as actor.id for a month, 2) add golden fixture for both envelope shapes, 3) add unit/regression test that covers the RBAC flattening + KMS envelope variants, 4) backfill integration checks in CI. I'll open the PR for (1) so we can get CI green.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/842 (compat shim + tests). will also add a deprecation TODO and telemetry counter when shim is used.

audit-bot: created issue #4321: "validator: accept legacy actor.service_actor.name and legacy kms_ref" and kicked off canary run.

sam: I'll add the golden fixtures to the repo under `goldens/keystore/legacy-envelope.json` and `goldens/keystore/new-envelope.json`. Also adding a CI gate that fails fast with a helpful error pointing to the PR.

lee: what's customer impact? Olivia from CS, any reports?

olivia: CS update: one integration partner (acct: acme-corp) reported audit rows missing actor_id yesterday; they rely on actor.id to reconcile actions. We're collecting the affected row IDs and will share a sample to reproduce.

raj: ok — prioritize fixing validator shim and patching staging. If samples confirm, prepare a customer-facing note and offer data backfill for affected users.

maria: landing the shim now. Plan to cut a patch release once canary is green. Will follow up here with timestamps. :hammer_and_wrench:

sam: I'll queue the goldens + CI test after the patch. Also will add an integration smoke job that runs a small keystore flow and validates audit output on PRs to catch regressions earlier.

security-oncall: nice. once patch is out, run a backfill verification against the last 24h of events in staging and prod (read-only) to quantify scope.

raj: thanks all. action items pinned: @maria (shim + release), @sam (goldens + CI tests), @lee (verify KMS envelope mapping), @olivia (collect customer samples). follow up in this thread with status updates — we'll update incident board if scope > single customer. :white_check_mark:
